description:
List what is new on streaming this week in one language and country: films and shows that just arrived on a service there, plus (for English, Korean and Japanese/anime) series with new episodes this week.

Use for 'new Telugu movies on OTT this week', 'what's new in Malayalam', 'new anime this week in India', 'new K-dramas', 'new Bangla releases in Bangladesh'.
Language accepts a name (Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, Malayalam, Kannada, Bengali/Bangla, Urdu, Punjabi, Marathi, English, Korean, Japanese, Filipino, Indonesian, Thai, Arabic, Turkish, Chinese...) or 'anime' / 'K-drama'. Omit it for the country's main language.

country.description: 2-letter ISO country code (e.g. IN, BD, PK, PH, US). Defaults to IN.

language.description: Language name or ISO code, or 'anime' / 'K-drama'.

name: new_this_week
title: New this week in a language
